'''MVK Esports''' is a [[:category:Vietnam|Vietnamese]] esports organisation. They previously competed under the name '''Vikings Gaming''' prior to their rebrand to '''Vikings Esports''', while on December 30th, 2025 it was announced the team would rebrand to '''MVK Esports'''. MVK stand for Mind, Vision, and Kinetics.
